marketing_description: The Speed Queen® Sanitizing Gas Dryer (DC5004WG) offers a 7 cu‑ft capacity and 710 rpm rotational speed, powered by a 22,000 Btu/hr gas motor. It features a galvanized steel drum, 5 temperature settings, 11 cycles, and a 120 V voltage rating with 220 cfm exhaust airflow through a 4‑in diameter outlet. Additional commercial features include anti‑static operation, commercial cool‑down technology, extended tumble, lint filter guard, moisture sensor, and steam options such as steam boost, steam refresh, and steam sanitize.
